Local knowledge, right where your property is.

Flourrish manages property in Chennai, Tamil Nadu. These are the localities currently covered. Owners can live anywhere; the property has to be here.

South Chennai & OMR

  • OMR (Old Mahabalipuram Road)
  • Velachery
  • Tambaram
  • Tambaram Radial Road
  • Adyar
  • Besant Nagar

ECR

  • ECR (East Coast Road)
  • Injambakkam

Central Chennai

  • Anna Nagar
  • Nungambakkam

Property somewhere else in Chennai?

Coverage grows as we take on properties. If your locality is not listed, send the address area in your enquiry and we will tell you honestly whether we can service it well. We would rather say no than manage a property badly from too far away.

Other Indian cities

Not yet. We will add a city only after operations there are in place. Until then, no coverage is claimed outside Chennai.

Owners outside India

Most owners we work with live in the United States, the Gulf, the United Kingdom, Singapore, Australia and Canada. Those are owner locations, not service locations: all properties under management are in Chennai.

Is your property in one of these areas?

Tell us the locality and property type. We will confirm coverage in our first reply.
